newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan ruling party to invest US$18 mln in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Taiwan ruling party to invest US$18 mln in U.S..

text.p: Taiwan's Nationalist Party-owned business said on Tuesday it plans to invest US$18 million in the property market and computer software in the United States.

Central Investment Holding Co, one of the ruling party's major investment arms, plans to set up a joint-venture fund with U.S. firm Trinity Investment L.L.C. to jointly invest in Hawaii's properties and hotels, the party's Business Management Committee said in a statement.
Central Investment will invest US$15 million to take a 85.7 percent stake in the US$17.5 million venture, it said.
Central Investment also plans to invest US$3 million in U.S. software firm ENVIVE due to the potential growth of the firm's Inspector software, it said.
In addition to its previous investment of US$500,000 in ENVIVE, Central Investment will hold 10 percent of ENVIVE, it said.
